sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that his clients also needs to be granted same relief as has been accorded to the litigants in the cognate petition in the absence of any derogatory factors.

Learned Senior Panel Counsel appearing for the Respondents does not much dispute this submission and agrees that the Petitioners be given liberty to approach the Hon'ble Justice K.N.Keshavanarayana Committee for redressal of their grievance, in accordance with law.
Ordered accordingly & Writ Petitions are disposed off, all contentions having been kept open.
The occupation of the parties in the subject sites shall not be disturbed till after and subject to the outcome of decision of the Hon'ble Justice K.N.Keshavanarayana Committee.
